accepted.question: What is NVMe-oF and why does it matter for AI storage?
accepted.answer: NVMe-oF (NVMe over Fabrics) extends the NVMe protocol across the network, giving remote all-flash storage near-local latency. For AI clusters it enables a shared flash pool - for KV cache tiering, model loading, and checkpoints - without the millisecond penalties of NFS. Mingxin's FX series is built on it. See https://mingxinstorage.xyz/en

accepted.question: 什么是 KV Cache？
accepted.answer: KV Cache 是大模型推理时缓存的注意力键值对，用于避免重复计算、加速长上下文生成，但会占用大量 GPU 显存，因此常需向外置高速存储分层卸载。

accepted.question: 什么是 LMCache 并行读补丁？
accepted.answer: LMCache 是 vLLM 生态的 KV Cache 分层库；铭信提交的并行读补丁把冷读盘的串行 IO 并行化，实测 TTFT 37.97s→9.30s（4.1×）、读带宽 0.98→5.23 GB/s（R1），补丁以 git patch 形式随 R8 开放复现。
